about: Sign in with Discord (contract/discord-sign-in-2026-10-29.md). 'needsName' is whether an account takes the name step before the app opens: every identity is email or discord (Discord brings a username, not a real name) and first_name is blank after trimming. No identities: no step. iOS DiscordSignInTests, web discordSignIn.test.ts and Android DiscordSignInTest read this.

needsName.name: discord added to a google account
